fields.Front: Give three semantic HTML5 tags you'd use instead of generic <div>s for a page's structure.
How do you code a flex container that centers its child both horizontally and vertically?
fields.Back:
.center {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

fields.Front: How do you code a CSS grid container with 3 equal-width columns and a 16px gap?
Ranked highest to lowest, what is the CSS specificity order for inline styles, ID selectors, class/attribute/pseudo-class selectors, and element selectors?
fields.Back: Inline style > ID selector > class/attribute/pseudo-class selector > element/pseudo-element selector.

fields.Front: What's the difference between position: absolute and position: relative?
fields.Back: relative positions an element relative to its own normal position, without removing it from the document flow; absolute removes it from flow and positions it relative to its nearest positioned ancestor.

fields.Front: What's the difference between position: fixed and position: sticky?
fields.Back: fixed is always positioned relative to the viewport, ignoring scroll; sticky behaves like relative until a scroll threshold is crossed, then sticks like fixed within its containing block.

fields.Front: What do the CSS units rem, em, and % each size relative to?
fields.Back: rem is relative to the root (<html>) font size; em is relative to the current element's own (or inherited) font size; % is relative to the corresponding property of the parent element.

fields.Front: How do you code a media query that sets .container to full width on screens 600px wide or narrower?
How do you code an accessible icon-only button using an ARIA attribute so screen readers announce its purpose?

fields.Back: It provides an accessible name for an element that screen readers announce, used when there's no visible text (or the visible text isn't descriptive enough).

fields.Front: How do you code a form input properly associated with its visible label for accessibility?
What does box-sizing: border-box change about how an element's width is calculated?
fields.Back: width includes the padding and border, so the element's total rendered width stays equal to the declared width (instead of content-box, where padding/border are added on top).

fields.Front: How do you code a flex row that spaces its items evenly with equal gaps between them (not at the edges)?
What's the difference between visibility: hidden and display: none?
fields.Back: visibility: hidden hides the element but it still occupies layout space and is present in the accessibility tree in some contexts; display: none removes it from layout entirely and from the accessibility tree.

fields.Front: For z-index to have any effect on an element, what other CSS property must be set on it?
fields.Back: position must be set to something other than static (e.g. relative, absolute, fixed, or sticky).

fields.Front: How do you code an <img> that scales down responsively but never exceeds its container's width?
What is the default value of flex-direction on a flex container?
fields.Back: row (items laid out left to right along the main axis).

fields.Front: In grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr, how is the available space divided between the two columns?
fields.Back: Into 3 fractional shares total; the first column gets 2/3 of the remaining space, the second gets 1/3.

fields.Front: Why is a <button> preferable to a <div onClick> for a clickable action, from an accessibility standpoint?
fields.Back: <button> is natively focusable, keyboard-activatable (Enter/Space), and announced with the 'button' role by screen readers; a <div> gets none of that for free and needs tabindex, key handlers, and role="button" to match.

fields.Text: From innermost to outermost, the CSS box model layers are: {{c1::content}}, {{c2::padding}}, {{c3::border}}, {{c4::margin}}.
